applicability: researcher method guidance; recheck when GitHits changes its changelog ingestion cadence.

evidence.environment: GitHits MCP via researcher agent, Claude Code session
evidence.source_reference: sde-agents:researcher packet 2026-08-09, openai/codex premise re-verification for LANE-001: pkg_changelog latest rust-v0.142.5 (2026-07-01) vs GitHub releases rust-v0.147.0 (2026-08-07), while the code index served sha a16863f8 matching live HEAD

expected_behavior: Release-recency claims are corroborated against the GitHub releases page before citing latest; GitHits changelog freshness is expected to lag its code-index freshness on fast-moving repositories.
observation: GitHits pkg_changelog in repo-url mode served a release feed over one month stale for openai/codex while the same repository's code index resolved exact-current HEAD, so a researcher citing latest release from the changelog tool alone would have reported a version five stable releases behind.
